context: docs/MILESTONE-2-STEP-2-PILOT.md flagged, at freeze time, that LOVE and REKR each had 3 candidates in the pool instead of the expected 2, without resolving why. Both are resolved here by reading the actual filings, not by inference.

rekr_2025_10_14.finding: The 8-K's own Item 2.02 text states this is 'preliminary, unaudited financial results... including expected revenue, gross margin, and Adjusted EBITDA ranges' and explicitly names the full third-quarter results and investor call as scheduled for 2025-11-13 -- which is the other REKR candidate already in this same pool. This is a pre-announcement of estimated ranges, not the quarterly results release itself; it passed the freeze's Item-2.02 screen mechanically without being the kind of event this study measures.
rekr_2025_10_14.disposition_reason: not_a_qualifying_earnings_event: preliminary/guidance-range pre-announcement, not the full quarterly results release (the full release for the same quarter is REKR's separate 2025-11-13 candidate already in this pool)
rekr_2025_10_14.distinct_from: This is NOT a same-day-competing-catalyst exclusion (docs/SAME-DAY-COMPETING-CATALYST-POLICY.md doesn't apply here) -- it's an event-type eligibility exclusion. Resolves the 'REKR has 3 candidates instead of 2' open note.

love_three_candidates.finding: All three candidates carry only Item 2.02/9.01 -- no preliminary-guidance language, no extra items, no duplicate accession numbers. Three quarterly reports (~3 months apart) fit inside the 7-month step-2 window because Lovesac's fiscal year is offset from the calendar year (a retailer reporting Q1/Q2/Q3 in June/September/December), not because of any data or freeze error.
love_three_candidates.verdict: NOT AN ANOMALY -- all three are genuine, distinct quarterly earnings events
love_three_candidates.disposition: no exclusion; all 3 remain candidates pending the remaining gates

not_a_claim: Excluding REKR 2025-10-14 and clearing LOVE does not mark any remaining candidate 'included' -- the corporate-action check, identity/exchange re-verification, and a label-engine dry run are still pending for every step-2 candidate that remains.
